edits.why: Switch the runtime image to nginx:1.28-trixie so its OpenSSL 3.5 provides ML-KEM groups for nginx TLS termination.
Raise the go directive to 1.24 so Go's default key exchange includes X25519MLKEM768 (go < 1.24 implies GODEBUG tlsmlkem=0).
Set CurvePreferences to X25519MLKEM768 first, keeping X25519 and P-256 so hybrid clients get ML-KEM while classical-only clients still connect.
Change ssl_ecdh_curve to X25519MLKEM768:X25519:prime256v1 so the edge negotiates hybrid ML-KEM while still accepting classical-only clients.

summary: Enable hybrid ML-KEM key exchange: pin X25519MLKEM768 first with X25519/P-256 fallback in the Go listener and nginx, bump go.mod to 1.24 for Go's ML-KEM default, and move the nginx runtime image to trixie (OpenSSL 3.5). RS256 and cert verification untouched.
